checks.name: Escalation completeness
checks.definition:
checks for cp_notifications:
  - failed rows:
      name: Escalation completeness
      fail query: |
        SELECT n.notification_id
        FROM cp_notifications n
        LEFT JOIN cp_investigations i ON n.notification_id = i.notification_id
        WHERE n.outcome = 'Investigation opened' AND i.investigation_id IS NULL
      # 0/0 on clean runs (cp_investigations is only ever built from
      # notifications with this exact outcome) - genuinely catches the
      # dirty(amber/red) near-duplicate notifications
      # apply_cp_notifications_presets injects, since each duplicate keeps
      # its source row's outcome but gets a perturbed notification_id that
      # cp_investigations never references. Confirmed for real: 0 clean,
      # 2-3 amber, 6 on the red run - same numbers
      # child-protection-contract.yaml's matching rule found.
      # Explicit high ceiling, not reliance on Soda's own (documented,
      # unfixed) bug that "failed rows" checks ignore samples limit
      # entirely (GitHub sodadata/soda-core#1985 - see plans/qa-
      # pipeline.md #29's correction).
      samples limit: 100000
      attributes:
        check_id: 
          data-asset-1.child-protection-family-support.cp-notifications.stg_cp_notifications.notification_id.escalation_completeness_soda
        introduced_date: "2023-01-15"
        description: "Every notification with outcome 'Investigation opened' must
          have a matching investigation record."
        changelog: []
